thread:
Samir (AE): Hey team — NovumHealth POC is ready to close but procurement has a couple of odd asks. They want e-sign delegation to a UK subsidiary + a notarized addendum for the local contract. Also asked for PO (net45) and bank remit instructions. Can legal/finance help unblock?

Tara (Legal): Quick clarifying Q — do they require a physical notary (wet ink) or will an e-notarization / notarized affidavit suffice? If physical, that complicates our standard flow. If e-notary allowed, we can accept DocuSign Notary or equivalent.

Linh (RevOps): Uploading the PO and vendor packet now: https://drive.redwood/novum/purchase_order.pdf. PO is in the name "NovumHealth Ltd" (UK). They included a KYC form and a blank PoA template.

Mark (Finance): Net45 is OK from finance side but we need valid vendor banking details + W-8/W-9 or local tax form. Also confirm that payments go to "NovumHealth Ltd" bank account — cannot accept payments to a different entity.

Olivia (SE): From POC perspective, they want the SLA bumped to 99.95 for the Dedicated pool. We can offer that with committed capacity. Suggest we add a fallback credit clause if we miss it.

Tara (Legal): I can do a quick redline for the MSA that includes: (1) optional clause for e-notarization (DocuSign Notary or local e-notary) and (2) a PoA verification clause ("PoA dated within 12 months, notarized or e-notarized"). That should cover both physical and e-notary. Will also add DPA tweak for UK data residency.

Samir (AE): Customer insists signature must be by the UK rep with PoA. They said they'll upload PoA PDF. They also want the order form to include a remit-to section and bank details. Any blockers?

Tara (Legal): No blockers if PoA is provided and KYC checks out. I'll add a short clause: "Signature authority to be evidenced by a Power of Attorney or equivalent document, dated within the prior 12 months, and notarized or e-notarized." Also will include fallback language for SLA credits.

Linh (RevOps): PoA uploaded to folder — it's a scanned EU notary stamp, not DocuSign Notary. I ran a basic vendor check; name on PoA is "Jonathan Meyers" but PO lists "J. Meyers" — small mismatch. Flagging for legal/finance.

Mark (Finance): If names don't match exactly, we need either: corrected PoA, a cover letter from company on letterhead confirming signatory, or enhanced KYC. Also ask them to fill in the remit-to block on the order form:

```
Remit-To: [Bank name]\nAccount: [IBAN/Sort code]\nBeneficiary: [Legal entity name]\n```

Samir (AE): I'll request corrected PoA + bank remit form + confirm they accept an e-notary clause. I'll push redline to them EOD and loop back once they return docs. :thumbsup:

Tara (Legal): Sounds good. I'll attach redline (MSA + order form + DPA) — includes optional e-notary wording and PoA verification. Sending to Samir for customer share.

Olivia (SE): If we get 99.95 SLA request accepted, let ops know so we can allocate Dedicated pool sizing. I'll draft a short appendix for the order form that captures committed GPUs and throughput.

Samir (AE): Thanks everyone — pushing now. Will update thread when Novum replies.
